apps.name: BYD Localized
apps.subtitle: English, Arabic and Russian + customizable tabs
apps.localizedDescription:
Unofficial localized BYD 9.16.0. Choose English, Arabic or Russian in Me → Settings → Language. Hide Discover, Mall and Service individually. My Car uses the original car icon. Fully close and reopen BYD after changing language.

Revision 2 restores the Bluetooth badges on supported dashboard controls.

Requires AltStore Classic and AltServer to be configured. Install and update with your own Apple account. AltStore installation and startup have been verified on an iPhone XS; the maintainer reports successful testing on additional iPhones.

Some Chinese artwork and live content remain untranslated. The profile page may be blank. Wakeup unlock is not included. Apple-restricted capabilities such as Wallet car keys and push notifications are not promised for this sideloaded build. Not affiliated with or endorsed by BYD.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes missing Bluetooth badges on supported dashboard controls when the car is connected. Adds the existing BYD badge PNG at the resource path used by the dashboard. Bluetooth connection checks, control logic, translations and other app code are unchanged. Update your existing installation through AltStore.

First public beta: English/Arabic/Russian language selection, configurable bottom tabs, and My Car icon. Includes existing launch, network and post-login fixes. AltStore runtime compatibility awaits independent testing.
